description: 开发工作流工具。dev_loop: 执行 GDScript,可选项目验证/bridge 截图查询/验收断言/状态保存。scene_snapshot: 结构化场景树快照。batch_validate: 批量脚本验证。create_files: 批量创建文件(支持自动验证 .gd)。run_verify: 批量运行 headless 验证场景。diff_scenes: 比较两个场景文件差异。

assertions.description: 代码执行后运行的断言数组

expect.description: 期望输出值(字符串比较)

expect_present.description: screenshot_diff: 场景树中应可见的节点名

frames_dir.description: frame_degradation: 帧截图目录(acceptance.frame_sequence 捕获时可省略)

gdscript.description: 用 _mcp_output 输出结果的 GDScript 代码

reference_path.description: screenshot_diff: 余弦相似度预筛的参考图路径(可选)

sim_threshold.description: screenshot_diff: 余弦相似度阈值(默认 0.85)

frame_sequence.description: 断言运行前捕获 N 帧到证据目录;帧供 frame_degradation 断言

interval_frames.description: ~60fps 下每次捕获间隔帧数(1-300,默认 10)

action.description: 操作类型。dev_loop=执行+验证一体, scene_snapshot=场景树快照, batch_validate=批量脚本验证, create_files=批量创建文件, run_verify=批量验证场景, diff_scenes=场景差异比较

bridge.description: dev_loop: 可选 Game Bridge,代码执行后截图/查询验证

queries.description: 代码执行后要跑的 bridge 查询(最多 10 条)

path.description: 游戏内截图保存路径(默认 user://mcp_dev_screenshot.png)

capture_tree.description: run_verify: Capture scene tree snapshot (default: false)

code.description: dev_loop: 要执行的 GDScript 代码(片段或完整 extends SceneTree)

files.description: create_files: Array of files to create

godot_path.description: 覆盖 Godot 二进制路径（可选，优先于项目配置和环境变量）

ignore_properties.description: diff_scenes: Property names to ignore in diff (default: metadata/_edit_lock)

load_autoloads.description: dev_loop: 是否加载 Autoload 上下文(默认 true)

max_depth.description: scene_snapshot: 最大遍历深度(默认 5)

project_path.description: Godot 项目目录路径（可选，默认使用 GODOT_PROJECT_PATH 环境变量或当前目录）

save_state.description: dev_loop: 保存会话状态到文件

files_modified.description: 本次会话修改的文件清单

path.description: 状态文件路径(相对项目,默认 production/session-state/active.md)

scene_a.description: diff_scenes: First scene path relative to project

scene_b.description: diff_scenes: Second scene path relative to project

scene_path.description: scene_snapshot: 场景文件路径(相对项目)

scenes.description: run_verify: Array of scene paths relative to project

scripts.description: batch_validate: 脚本路径数组(相对项目)

timeout.description: dev_loop: 每步超时秒数(默认 30)

validate.description: create_files: Validate .gd files after creation (default: true)

verify.description: dev_loop: 执行后是否跑项目验证(默认 false)

name: workflow
